annotations.title: Find it cheaper at another retailer

description: Given a product (by Lowvyn ID or retailer URL), return the same physical product on other Canadian retailers with their current prices and savings. Uses verified UPC matches. Use this when a user wants to know 'can I get this cheaper somewhere else?'. checkUrl and extensionUrl are returned when the product is not tracked yet.
